text:
The quotation announces an expansion of a programme providing refurbishment grants to councils — the specific mechanism is intergovernmental grant funding for building/property refurbishment. The key dimensions are: (1) grants flowing from central government to local councils (intergovernmental fiscal transfers → H7), and (2) the grants are for refurbishment of physical structures, touching real estate/building stock (R3).

{"primary": "H7", "secondary": ["R3"]}
